title: FACET Project Wiki
description: Configuration for a registry wiki. Page content is stored in Markdown under the wiki directory.

areas.description: Areas keyed by directory name, in display order.

categories.description: Categories available to pages, in display order.

depth.description: Maximum folder depth before the wiki reports a warning.

title.description: What this area is called, in the project's own language — the heading a reader sees above its pages, rather than the folder name they would otherwise be shown. Required, because the alternative is a surface showing a slug to a person; an area nobody has named is simply an undeclared folder, which is already a state this file has an answer for.

purpose.description: One line: what belongs in this area, and by implication what does not. Optional, and worth writing anyway — it is the sentence somebody consults when deciding where a new page goes, and the same line the taxonomy asks for on a domain, for the same reason.

domain.description: Optional taxonomy domain associated with this area.

id.description: What a page names this category by, in its 'category' header key. A slug rather than the heading itself, so rewording the heading touches one line instead of every page that names it. The grammar is the segment grammar ids already use, so a project reading this file reads both the same way.

title.description: The heading, in the project's own language — what a reader sees.

purpose.description: One line: which pages belong under this heading. Optional, and the sentence somebody consults when deciding what a new page is.
